Cricket is the most loved and popular sport in India. People worship cricketers, cry when they lose, celebrate in their wins. But the game has garnered attention not only for the game that it is but also for the vices committed under its name.
Betting and match fixing have been two most unfamous words associated with the game. Time and again small and big names have been found involved in these illegal practices. 
These practices have not been limited to the involvement of bookies or cricketers but enough links have been found between match fixings and underworld. 
How these bets are placed, how did police discover betting and fixing, which all famous cricketers have been guilty of in this malpractice. How betting has evolved over time, what's this nexus, let's discuss.
